name: Crescent Reflector Reef
core_rationale: Northern parabolic silver-coral reef of Libration Mirror Shoals at [1, 0] that focuses twilight starlight into a blinding horizon beam.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Tide-watchers say that looking directly at Crescent Reflector Reef without smoked syzygy glass shows your own silhouette walking three steps ahead of you.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A curved crescent of mirror-polished silver coral rising out of the northern tide pools.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What constellation citadel is revealed when Crescent Reflector Reef focuses its midnight beam?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northern reflector rim of Libration Mirror Shoals along scar-vesper-crater.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Parabolic silver-coral reef focusing twilight starlight across oscillating mirror pools.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: terrain tile and prop kit metrics for 1.05m characters will be bound when promoted to Canon.
